name: CMIP6 Historical Ocean and Biogeochemical Simulations
model_or_instrument: 18 CMIP6 models (ACCESS-ESM1-5, CanESM5, CanESM5-CanOE, CESM2, CESM2-FV2, CESM2-WACCM, CESM2-WACCM-FV2, CNRM-ESM2-1, GFDL-CM4, IPSL-CM6A-LR, MIROC-ES2L, MRI-ESM2-0, MPI-ESM1-2-LR, MPI-ESM1-2-HR, MPI-ESM-1-2-HAM, NorESM2-LM, NorESM2-MM, UKESM1-0-LL)

scales.note: CMIP6 historical simulation outputs (1959–2014) regridded to a uniform 1° × 1° horizontal grid with monthly resolution.
